intents.setup: Set up or adjust Design project integration. Preview exact writes and require confirmation; optional hooks stay opt-in.
intents.status: Explain the current Design configuration, available canonical context and optional hook state without changing anything.
intents.diagnose: Investigate Design integration problems, conflicts or configuration drift. Report findings and proposed remedies without applying them.

intents.detect: Run the local deterministic detector on explicitly named files or directories. Do not infer targets, enable hooks or fix findings.

intents.questionnaire: Create a stakeholder questionnaire for a product or interface decision. Preview the complete draft before approval of one exact Markdown destination; never send it or change project context.

intents.review: Assess the interface impact of Git changes, a branch, commit or pull request. A general review of a page without change scope belongs to Impeccable critique.
